06359a1815.q: Why is Slight Reliability podcast ending after four and a half years and 125 episodes?
06359a1815.a: The host decided to end the podcast because they have been producing two podcasts simultaneously alongside their day job, family commitments, and other hobbies, which has stretched them too thin. While creating Slight Reliability has been an act of love and obligation to the community, it requires significant time and energy. The host is choosing to focus on Tales from the Humpback Sky instead, a collaborative creative project that feeds their energy and provides a counterbalance to their career work.

868bb9771e.q: What is Tales from the Humpback Sky podcast and who creates it?
868bb9771e.a: Tales from the Humpback Sky is a tabletop role-playing game podcast created by the Slight Reliability host alongside Paul Harrop and Tom Wardle. It is a collaborative and creative project not tied to anyone's career, focused on imagination and creativity. The podcast has around 60 regular listeners, and the host is proud of what it has become, particularly the story arc of the first season.
